LanguageData.ChargeableBionics.EnableProstheticPatche: When enabled, basic industrial prosthetics (prosthetic limbs, cochlear implants, power claws, and similar Royalty implants) also need to be recharged, using a lower capacity tier than true bionics. When disabled, these prosthetics behave as in vanilla.
LanguageData.ChargeableBionics.RestartRequired: Changes to this setting require a restart or mod list reload to take effect.
